prompts.name: choreo-16
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Edit this square dance cover. Preserve EXACTLY its brand layout, ivory #F5F2EC background, red diagonal brushstroke, logo, face identity/hair, clothing, title, age and website. The ONLY meaningful change is the dancer's body pose and consequently hands/shadows. User says the first three posters' low wide squats/lunges look too similar and the hands look anatomically unnatural. Replace this with a distinctly different realistic dance movement as specified below. All printed text stays in exact current position and fully readable, no dancer overlaps title/age. Photorealistic body under coherent natural light, do not paste head onto another body, believable body proportions, no extra arms or fingers, exactly five fingers per hand. Natural wrist continuation from forearm; no twisted wrists, melted palms, wide unnatural fan gestures or hidden missing fingers. Whole person and both feet inside square. Image1 edit target. Single finished square3000x3000 cover, not grid/variants.
New pose: a realistic UPRIGHT choreographic turning cross-step captured mid-movement, hips and torso rotated three-quarter toward camera-left, stepping one foot across the other with both soles close to floor. Torso tall and clearly upright, absolutely no squat or wide lunge. One elbow lifted away from torso with hand relaxed near shoulder height, other arm reaches diagonally backward/down at waist level, relaxed natural hands with softly curled separated fingers. Dynamic hair and slight shoulder rotation convey hiphop/jazz-funk transition. Lower-right figure area, hands inside right half away from typography. Clear rhythmic confident energy. Same black sweatshirt/cargo trousers/white sneakers. Preserve words CHOREO,16+,oneofstudio.ru and ONE OF STUDIO logo unchanged.
